Name: Dizor's Wizard Redraw
Author: Dizor
Description:
I felt for as tall and thin as the Wizard's overworld sprite is, his portrait is awfully squat and dwarfish.
Ended up layering the old sprite behind the new one and liked the accidental wild hair look it gave over the previous straight hair I'd drawn, so this is the result.

Simply extract to your base Stardew Valley folder and replace the old file.
Remember to back up your files etc etc.
